name: Authyo ChatLead – Chatbot Lead Capture
author: Konceptwise Digital Media Pvt Ltd

sections.description:
Authyo ChatLead – Chatbot Lead Capture is a powerful lead capture plugin that combines an interactive chatbot interface with secure OTP (One-Time Password) verification for both email and phone numbers. Perfect for businesses that want to collect verified contact information from their website visitors.

Key Features

  • Interactive Chatbot – Engaging conversational interface for lead capture
  • Email OTP Verification – Verify email addresses with one-time passwords
  • Phone OTP Verification – Verify phone numbers with SMS OTP
  • Country Selection – Automatic country code handling with cached country list
  • Form Builder – Drag-and-drop interface to customize chatbot fields
  • Lead Management – View, filter, and search leads from admin dashboard
  • Accessibility – ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, screen reader support
  • Responsive Design – Works perfectly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
  • Widget Support – Optional floating widget for site-wide deployment
  • Shortcode – [authyo_chatlead] (or the legacy [chatlead_by_authyo]) for embedding in pages/posts

Supported Field Types

  • Name
  • Email (with OTP verification)
  • Phone (with country code and OTP verification)
  • Message
  • Number
  • Address

Use Cases

  • Lead generation for sales teams
  • Contact form with verified information
  • Newsletter signups with email verification
  • Customer support inquiries
  • Event registrations
  • Quote requests

Requirements

  • Authyo API credentials (get them at authyo.io)
  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.2 or higher

Privacy Policy

This plugin stores lead information (name, email, phone, message) in your WordPress database. The plugin uses the Authyo API to send and verify OTP codes. Please review Authyo’s privacy policy at https://authyo.io/privacy-policy/ for information about how OTP data is handled. No other third-party services are involved in the data flow or storage of lead information.

Support

For support, please visit authyo.io/contact or contact us at support@authyo.io.

Credits

Developed by Authyo – Secure authentication and verification solutions.

Konceptwise is the main company and Authyo is a product under Konceptwise Digital Media Pvt Ltd.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the authyo-chatlead folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Authyo ChatLead → Settings and enter your Authyo API credentials
  4. Click “Refresh Country List” to cache the country data
  5. Go to Authyo ChatLead → Form Builder to customize your chatbot fields
  6. Add the shortcode [authyo_chatlead] to any page or post
  7. Alternatively, enable the floating widget in settings for site-wide deployment
sections.faq:
How do I get Authyo API credentials?

Visit authyo.io to sign up for an account and obtain your App ID, Client ID, and Client Secret.

Can I customize which fields appear in the chatbot?

Yes! Go to Authyo ChatLead → Form Builder to add, remove, reorder, and configure fields. You can enable/disable fields, change labels and placeholders, and set required status.

Can I use the chatbot on multiple pages?

Yes! You can either:
1. Add the [authyo_chatlead] shortcode to specific pages/posts
2. Enable the floating widget in settings for site-wide deployment

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

The plugin stores lead data in your WordPress database. You are responsible for ensuring compliance with GDPR and other privacy regulations. We recommend adding appropriate privacy notices and obtaining consent before collecting personal data.

What happens to my data if I uninstall the plugin?

When you uninstall (not just deactivate) the plugin, all data is permanently removed including:
* Plugin settings
* Lead database table
* Cached country list
* Scheduled events
